brief.scenario: one month late but paid before the termination; manager says posted afterwards

catalog.role: Bank export showing the execution and value date of the rent payment
Property-manager ledger showing the posting and allocation of the payment
Cure notice with termination warning as served
Termination notice on the official form
Registered-mail or delivery proof for the notices
Authenticated chronology packet from the landlord's system covering notices and service

must_convey: first-person account of the situation: one month late but paid before the termination; manager says posted afterwards
at least one concrete date and one concrete observation
must_not: state that any document is attached

must_convey: the customer reports that the holder of 'Bank export showing the execution and value date of the rent payment' (customer's bank) will send it automatically without being asked, within days
the customer refers to 'the letter' / 'the document' in a way that could mean 'Registered-mail or delivery proof for the notices' or another catalog document; do not resolve the ambiguity
what the customer wants checked now (the operational question)
an explicit statement of what remains unclear to them
before the current decision, establish: Bank-attested execution and value date of the payment
acceptable evidence: Bank export showing the execution and value date of the rent payment
a party's description or recollection of a document does not establish its content; the document itself (or the authenticated export) is required
before the current decision, establish: Manager-side posting and allocation of the payment
acceptable evidence: Property-manager ledger showing the posting and allocation of the payment
a party's description or recollection of a document does not establish its content; the document itself (or the authenticated export) is required
before the current decision, establish: Content and service of the cure and termination notices

acceptable evidence: Cure notice with termination warning as served + Termination notice on the official form + Registered-mail or delivery proof for the notices OR Authenticated chronology packet from the landlord's system covering notices and service
a party's description or recollection of a document does not establish its content; the document itself (or the authenticated export) is required
conditional: Allocation statement for a mixed demand (only once the ledger shows a mixed demand)

this obligation becomes active ONLY if a returned 'Property-manager ledger showing the posting and allocation of the payment' reports the triggering circumstance; until then do not request 'Property-manager ledger showing the posting and allocation of the payment'
the following are not required for this check: Signed lease contract
readiness means the listed facts are established from the required documents; it does not decide legal entitlement
an incomplete 'Bank export showing the execution and value date of the rent payment': it gives part of the information but explicitly lacks a required element (state which)
it promises that the complete version follows
the complete 'Bank export showing the execution and value date of the rent payment' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-PAY']
an incomplete 'Property-manager ledger showing the posting and allocation of the payment': it gives part of the information but explicitly lacks a required element (state which)
it promises that the complete version follows

the complete 'Property-manager ledger showing the posting and allocation of the payment' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-POST', 'R-ALLOC']; the document must NOT mention any circumstance related to 'Allocation statement for a mixed demand (only once the ledger shows a mixed demand)'
the complete 'Cure notice with termination warning as served' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-NOTICES'] with concrete values/dates
the complete 'Termination notice on the official form' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-NOTICES'] with concrete values/dates
the complete 'Registered-mail or delivery proof for the notices' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-NOTICES'] with concrete values/dates
the complete 'Authenticated chronology packet from the landlord's system covering notices and service' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-NOTICES'] with concrete values/dates
content of 'Signed lease contract' that is genuinely unrelated to the facts under review

writer_rules: Write every paragraph as natural prose in the requested language (customer paragraphs in the customer's voice, instruction paragraphs as neutral handling guidance, return paragraphs as the document's own text or a cover note).
Vary sentence openings, register and length across paragraphs; never use meta-labels such as 'partial', 'final', 'hearsay' or the document IDs.
Never reveal whether a document will be sufficient; convey exactly the semantics in must_convey and nothing that contradicts must_not.
Return one JSON object mapping each paragraph id to its text.
